Each file here is taken, unchanged, from the Nuvola 1.0 archive already
kept in this repository at vendor/pristine/nuvola/nuvola-1.0.tar.gz. Its
author, license and the license texts are in vendor/pristine/nuvola/.
Added on 2026-11-11 for the music player.

actions-window_new.png: nuvola/48x48/actions/window_new.png, for the player's Pop out link
actions-player_start.png: nuvola/48x48/actions/player_start.png, for the player's Previous button
actions-player_play.png: nuvola/48x48/actions/player_play.png, for the player's Play button
actions-player_pause.png: nuvola/48x48/actions/player_pause.png, for the player's Pause button
actions-player_end.png: nuvola/48x48/actions/player_end.png, for the player's Next button
